Xenotransplantation.lore: Your flesh is but a weak imitation of power, a flabby welter of gushing blood and brittle bones, stitched together with threads of weak hope. There is only one way through: you must supplement your failing heart.

majorIds.Vitriol: +Vitriol: Uncontainable Corruption decreases Corrupted duration by 75% and gives drastically more damage, but disables Enraged Blow. Massacre adds 5 times as much corruption.

Voltaic Tome of Combat Mastery II.internalName: Voltaic Tome of Combat Mastery II

Repose.lore:
Found on the mangled body of a famous Tromsian general fallen to a corrupted siege some time ago, these boots allow the wearer to remain calm and steadfast in the face of overwhelming odds.
It's pulling towards something.

Umami.lore: Rumors circulate of a once-cook from Lutho who managed to achieve the perfect meal. In their final days, they preserved its essence in this necklace, in a hope that someone else would be able to share the experience they had.

Enhanced Coalwalkers.lore: Even ignoring the numerous scorches all over, these boots hardly look any better.

majorIds.Combo Stomp: +Combo Stomp: Landing directly on an enemy with Fierce Stomp sends you back into the air and resets Escape.

Buoyant Balmorals.lore: These are congealed and rather gross, but they leave you with an undeniable bounce in your step.

Web Spitter.lore: "And you thought walking into a cobweb was bad." -Ope, Ragni Botanist

Courageous Tome of Defensive Mastery II.internalName: Courageous Tome of Defensive Mastery II

Labyrinth.lore: Left. Right. Left. Right. They are desperate for an escape, merely playthings in a maze of your design. Left. Left. Right.  Turn back. When mountains of stone can shift at your command, their world is reduced to a single path. Left. Right. Does it ever end?

majorIds.Twisting Threads: +Twisting Threads: Tangled Traps ropes gain +1 range, can overlap up to 3 times, and deal 50%. Gain +12 traps with 66% duration that cannot be triggered by enemies.

Abhorrence.lore: The last of her crimes was against herself. She reviled and hated, shattering any glass in which she might see her own cruel visage.

Decaybound Spindle.lore: Decay spreads unseen, but you know it spreads, and that is enough.

majorIds.Gruesome Knots: +Gruesome Knots: Bleeding and Twisted Tether deal double damage, but Bleeding duration is reduced.

majorIds.Paragon: +Paragon: Shield Strike deals 600% damage. Mantle of the Bovemist's cooldown is reduced by 15s, but is limited to one shield charge.

Treasured Diamond Mask of Legendary Vict.internalName: Treasured Diamond Mask of Legendary Victory
Treasured Diamond Mask of Legendary Vict.lore: This excessively ornate to-the-point-of-being-wasteful decorative mask, laser-cut from a meter's worth of pure diamond, is given to those who have spent an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge, broken the mold by continuing to spend an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge, gone even further beyond spending unnecessary amounts of time completing the Legendary Challenge, and then pushed onward to prove that they will not stop spending unnecessary amounts of time completing the Legendary Challenge.

Dogfight.lore:
The Nesaak wolves have been driven to aggression by corruption. Witnesses have seen entire packs decimate each other in fierce and brutal skirmishes. This necklace is adorned with teeth recovered from those incidents, and wearing it gives you the feeling of a wolf about to bite at your neck.
It's pulling towards something.

Katoa's Warmth.lore: Brilliantly golden as the crops from the humble farm, its mere presence fills stomachs and brings comfort, but only to those who are modest and generous.

Sorcerer's Tome of Combat Mastery II.internalName: Sorcerer's Tome of Combat Mastery II

Cremation.lore:
The dead are often burned to nullify the risk of return. For creatures of corruption, however, that fire can be enough for them to rise again.
It's pulling towards something.

Broken Sandust.lore: The silver looks rather tarnished...does he expect you to believe that "gem" isn't just a cheap glass bauble?

majorIds.Hawkeye: +Hawkeye: Arrow Hurricane becomes a condensed stream of 25 arrows, dealing 33%, 4%, and 4% each.

Winter's Essence.lore: These pure, snow-white leggings are rumored to have been crafted by the legendary ice mage Theorick. The people of Nesaak view them as cursed, seeking to destroy them in a bid to stop the endless winter surrounding them.

Indigo Wynnter Sweater.lore: The sweater has the quote "GRAUPELING with a second helping of Craftmas feast" knitted onto the front.

Gold Solar Ring.lore: The device forged into this advanced ring seems to absorb heat. You can feel a warming sensation all over your hand...

Infernal Tome of Combat Mastery II.internalName: Infernal Tome of Combat Mastery II

Almuj's Walker.lore: There used to be a constant battle between Almuj's thieves over these feather-light, gold-plated boots, until one day they were stolen by an unknown pickpocket and never seen again.

Chaos-Woven Greaves.lore: With threads of fundamentally opposing magic delicately woven together, these ornately-crafted greaves are given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.

majorIds.Escape Route: +Escape Route: Frenzy and Time Dilation charge twice as fast but also decay twice as fast.

Wynnter Fair 2017 Souvenir.lore: Thank you for participating in the 2017 Wynnter Fair!

Sprout.lore: "The plants loathe to take hold upon the red stone. And so, we must hunt instead."  -Caras, Owl Tribesman

Aftershock.lore: The Fracturing brought Ahms into a shattered sky, sundering cliffs into an archipelago against the void. The tremors that linger carry an ancient power, bringing mountains to heel with ease and leaving devastation in its wake.

Hurricane Recurve.lore: The winds are a curious thing. The light breeze is calming, pleasant. The gale buffets and breaks things, as though it were a child's tantrum. Only the storm truly destroys, bearing its gusts against anyone or anything that would stand in its way, leaving behind only ruin and dust.

Butterfly.lore: "Time travel cares less about small things like a flapping wing, and more about big things, like becoming your own grandfather." -Martyn, Time Valley Resident

Aphorism.lore: Just because it's been said to death doesn't mean it isn't true.

majorIds.Paragon: +Paragon: Shield Strike deals 600% damage. Mantle of the Bovemist's cooldown is reduced by 15s, but is limited to one shield charge.

Lost Tales.lore: You can hardly notice some text engraved on this bracelet. Looking closer, the worn-out inscriptions are telling the legends of an ancient hero whom you do not know of.

Inconceivably Deranged Paper Mask of Leg.internalName: Inconceivably Deranged Paper Mask of Legendary Victory
Inconceivably Deranged Paper Mask of Leg.lore: This cheap paper mask drawn in the likeness of Herbert von Legendary as he was having a complete nervous breakdown after having his life threatened by people who would not stop challenging him, is handed over in the ill-conceived hope of easing the murderous tendencies of those who have spent unnecessary amounts of time, broken the mold, gone even further beyond, pushed onward to prove that they will not stop, ultimately garnered an unhealthy obsession, and then came to blows in Doctor Legendary's house demanding further prizes all for the singularly unsettling and quite possibly sociopathic purpose of spending unnecessary amounts of time completing the Legendary Challenge. The inside has the names and addresses of multiple notable psychoanalysts written with a hastily-scrawled note from Doctor Legendary himself begging that you stop completing the Legendary Challenge and go get therapy before you do something to him that would constitute legal action against you.

Braker.lore: Seems like the name is misspelled a little bit.

Moontower.lore: For the belief of the cosmos’ defilement, the moon was noted to remain unchanged. Those with this belief live only for the light of the moon, desperately seeking to maintain it through means that would only darken the soul of the most devout. Such from them comes the word lunacy.

Diamond Steam Necklace.lore: This necklace is the pinnacle of steam-powered technology. Despite the size of the large jewel hanging from the necklace, it doesn't feel heavy at all.

Idealogue.lore: An attempt to bring power into the hands of one: wealth weaponized across a province to this end. A hero revolted. Crystals burned and plans were brought to dust.

Dulled Amethyst Ring.lore: The merchant insists the gem is real. It's easy to tell that the issue is the quality of the gem, though...

Silver Fusion Ring.lore: This ring, covered in colorful artifical gems, seems to awaken a strong elemental affinity in you. With some improvements to its core, it could become even better...

Inquisitor's Zeal.lore: They have pillaged your faithful houses and razed your sacred fields. Imbued within this lance is an aspect of holy power, and with it you will bring Hell itself up to meet these vile transgressors.

majorIds.Explosive Impact: +Explosive Impact: Exploding gives an additional chance to deal 300% Main Attack damage in a radius of 5 blocks upon killing an enemy.

Ten-Foot Pole.lore: I'm not touching this with a... well. Yeah.

Pisces.lore: The oddly uncomfortable helmet was hand sculpted from a mystic clay found only in the depths of Molten Heights. Not much is known about the substance.

Bad Wolf.lore: The runic message carved on these enigmatic boots cover hundreds of different languages, many of them disused, but what has been translated seems to describe a disaster soon to arrive to the world.

Silver Static Bracelet.lore: Though it's hard to touch the simple, mechanical bracelet without experiencing a little shock, its capabilities intrigue you...

Death's Reach.lore: "We'll ensure that under our watch, all your families will be reunited!" -Haros, of the Banished Legion

Silver Fusion Necklace.lore: This necklace, decorated with bright jewels, uses built-in micro-devices to boost its users elemental abilites. There are many upgrades to be made before it reaches its full potential.

Purity Filter.lore:
Originally intended to remove corruption from the world in small amounts, the item became ineffective after overuse. Traces of corruption linger in the metal, displaying the futility of attempting such a feat.
It's pulling towards something.

Gold Solar Necklace.lore: The device forged into this advanced necklace seems to gather heat. You can feel a warming sensation all over your neck...

Knucklebones.lore: An old Nemract saying is engraved along the metal. "A single toss of the knucklebones can make or break a gambling man."

Infernus Aeterna.lore:
From coals to conflagration, the flames of War flicker forever.
It's pulling towards something.

majorIds.Geocentrism: +Geocentrism: Aura radiates from you instead of your Totem and can be cast any time.

Wynnter Fair 2016 Souvenir.lore: Thank you for participating in the 2016 Wynnter Fair!

Green Wynnter Sweater.lore: The sweater has the quote "I'm feeling PINE, what about you" knitted onto the front.

Toaster.lore: \[Community Event Winner\] This peculiar weapon was once wielded by the firey warrior Igbar, who used it to great effect in endurance competitions.

majorIds.Totemic Fuse: +Totemic Fuse: Totemic Smash deals +40%, +90%, +90%, and +60% at the cost of half of Totem's duration.

Diamond Hydro Bracelet.lore: You'll fight strong like the tide, the merchant said, and no word was a lie. With this bracelet on your arm you could ride a wave with your bare feet.

Keratoconus.lore: The unearthly wood of eyestalk is durable, but with horrific cost. Pieces severed from the trunk continue to collect and cultivate the essence of abandoned eyes, and the unfortunate wearer becomes a catalyst for growth.

Water Sanctuary.lore: The depths of the seas, where the waves flow fierce and fast and wash away the agonies of the world.

Bedruthan.lore: Stone shorn from mountains by the roiling sea gathered on the shores of Llevigar one day, washed onto the sand in the shape of a massive spear. It was taken as an omen, and the stones were forged into a true weapon.

Divzer.lore: Unruly magics of void and darkness are tamed within this bow's string. While those energies are never to be released, arrows fired from it fire at such blinding speeds so as to phase out of existence when they hit their target.

Red Candle.lore: The flickering flame atop this simple wand is a marvel of magic. It always burns at a comfortable heat, cannot scorch skin even if touched, and never can be snuffed out under any circumstance.

Upgraded Flare Blitz.lore: The weapon nearly catches fire during the merchant's demonstration. He still refuses to discount it despite this.

Ventus Tail.lore: Fashioned from the cut tails of the now extinct Venti, these nearly immaterial boots are light as air and crackle with lightning.

Hexed Amulet.lore: Although the warlock's curse placed upon this simple, Olux-crafted charm will reduce the abilities of the wearer significantly, its original luck-bolstering properties still are in place.

Hecatomb.lore:
For the hundreds sacrificed for Troms's survival, death was not the end. Residual dark magic and corrupted energy manifests in this weapon as faint echoes of sorrow and agony from the slain who were denied peace.
It's pulling towards something.

Abyssal Amulet.lore: Used by the Order of the Abyss to aid their summoning rituals, it contains a strange, fiery energy. It has ties with a terrible demon...

Surveillance.lore: An attempt to rule with an iron fist, a power hellbent on control and force.  Unknown. How far does the indomitable spirit of humanity extend?

Abiogenesis.lore: Life itself is not a flexible material to work with—building sentience is precisely like squeezing blood from a stone. It may be years of toil, but the strength of an entire race that looks to you as a creator cannot be overstated.

Conductor.lore: Using an unorthodox method of smithing, these copper leggings are insulated with an extremely conductive blend of liquid to improve electrical discharge.

Crumbling Foundation.lore:
It always returns a little weaker than what it was before. Perhaps someday, it'll be put down for good.
It's pulling towards something.

majorIds.Entropy: +Entropy: Meteor's speed is increased by 50%.

Upgraded Scalpel.lore: The blade actually looks to be of good quality, unlike the other products. The only problem is the questionable stain covering most of it.

Elysium-Engraved Aegis.lore: Dedicated to a place of courage revered by all warriors, this ornately-crafted chestplate is given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.

Infernal Impulse.lore: If the depths of hell allows you this, is staying human an equal trade or a fool's choice?

majorIds.Rally: +Rally: Cleansing Breeze heals you for 15% and allies for 20%, but Charge becomes harmless.

Grisly Gauntlet.lore:
A thick layer of blood and gore coats this gauntlet. Every time you glance at it, images of being torn to pieces by the undead flash into your mind, and you shudder.
It's pulling towards something.

Zero.lore: The unstable power within this bow is capable of great destruction, but seems to zero out at the most crucial moments in battle. Only the most skillful archers can wield this weapon with confidence.

The Jingling Jester.lore: Jingle jangle, while shaking your bells. Jingle jangle come the pockets of cash... Catch the trickster, send them to hell," their money is gone and off you've dashed!

majorIds.Greed: +Greed: Picking up emeralds heals you and nearby players for 8% max health.

Taurus.lore: The hide of the Touroto, an almost invincible Bull-like creature, is said to be pierced only by the horn of the Touroto itself, making it extremely valuable.

Stingy.lore: "You should see when the spiders fight over a meal. It looks ridiculous, legs flailing everywhere!" -Captain Enduyn, Ragni Legion 1st Division

majorIds.Find Thyself: +Find Thyself: Masquerade now grants 75 Mana after switching between Masks 3 times.

Black Space.lore: Give yourself to darkness, and in darkness, answers will take shape.

Hex-Master Anchor.lore: Having felt the power of the Keep's hex, this jewel carries a familiar weight. Much like the Hex-Masters before you, you find channeling curses comes like second nature.

Maltic's Old Spear.lore: This short spear was the first weapon to be produced by the villagers for sale. They are old, but strong.

Kaze.lore: \[Community Event Winner\] Gentle spirits of the wind attract themselves to the brilliant jewels slotted into this ring, bringing peace to its wearers and those around them.

Enhanced Icarus.lore: Apparently, gluing some feathers on top of the decorative armor wings is supposed to allow you to fly- so says the merchant, at least.

Everlasting Tome of Defensive Mastery II.internalName: Everlasting Tome of Defensive Mastery II

Glare.lore: The blazing sun has been revered by many druidic sects as a god in its own right, and the jewel in this brilliant wand glows with the brightness of their holy star.

Cataclysm.lore: Despite the existence of the Nether Portal, few believe that it is possible to open such rifts with sheer force alone. None believe that a tool with enough power to accomplish such a monumental feat could exist. And yet...

Cyclonic Tome of Combat Mastery II.internalName: Cyclonic Tome of Combat Mastery II

Snowtread Boots.lore: According to the tag on the heels, these boots leave a trail of snow no matter  where one walks with them.

majorIds.Snowy Steps: +Snowy Steps: Leaves a trail of snow behind you.

Monster.lore: This wand merges with the user on touch, bringing about horrific changes to them. Elongated nails, sharp teeth and the ability to breathe fire are trademarks of the beast.

Guard's Garment.lore:
The previous owner seems to have met an untimely fate in the undead hordes outside Ragni. Stained but salvageable... a little corruption never hurt anybody, yet....
It's pulling towards something.

Infinitesimal.lore: For when one needs to carve the smallest stone or pick the smallest lock, the subtleties of precision approach impossibility.

Gale's Force.lore: Those who have used this near-weightless bow all seem to tell tales of how they see Gale's spirit fighting alongside them.

Wanderer's Purpose.lore: To look and say “I will go there,” and to keep going until you find it... that’s what’s important.

majorIds.Seeking Module: +Seeking Module: Homing Shots track towards nearby enemies much more aggressively.

Cerulean Wynnter Sweater.lore: The sweater has the quote "SLOPE to SKI you again next Craftmas" knitted onto the front.

majorIds.Explosive Impact: +Explosive Impact: Exploding gives an additional chance to deal 300% Main Attack damage in a radius of 5 blocks upon killing an enemy.

Scarlet Veil.lore: You're seeing red... Time to see more of it.

majorIds.Pounce: +Pounce: Escape becomes a forward lunge.

majorIds.Forest's Blessing: +Forest's Blessing: Your hound gains increased movement speed, attack speed, vision, and +60%. Arrow Bomb's damage is reduced by  -30%.

Hydrogen.lore: A blade crafted from the ocean's elements. It slices through enemies with the grace of the tides.

Diamond Fiber Necklace.lore: This ultimate version of a necklace was given to less than a handful of adventurers. Once on your neck, you can communicate with the ground below as if you grew roots.

majorIds.Methodical: +Methodical: Initiator's reset time is reduced by 75%. Arrow Bomb area damage is halved, but direct hit damage is doubled.

Bronze Basic Ring.lore: This ring is awarded to participants of the Legendary Challenge. Its modular design allows it to be upgraded in a number of different ways.

Capricorn.lore: During a spiritual journey to Kato temple, the sage Capian was presented with powerful spiritual boots with the intention to be used for peaceful magic, and not hard combat.

Molten Fleshmass.lore:
The scorching heat, the shifting bodies, the screeching cries of anguish... they're all the least of your problems now.
It's pulling towards something.

majorIds.Temblor: +Temblor: Bash gains +1 Area of Effect and is 0.05s faster.

Sage.lore: Discipline and experience is channeled into these wands for 10 years in the Bantisu monastery of the canyon, in the hope that they will pass on its teachings to less experienced users.

Hadal.lore: Carved from unknown parts of a sea creature unseen, the goliath scales of this effigy of the deep bring forth...a pull. A weight, a pressure. A terrible, crushing depth brought onto the holder, blanketing them like nostalgia. Their owner watches, part of itself acutely aware of its missing pieces.

Bovine Killer.lore: This helmet was worn long ago by an infamous assassin who plagued Bovemist sites for decades. It was crafted of the still-bloody skin of their most prized and worshiped cows.

Skull Breaker.lore: "Even a corrupted would get crushed by one of these!" -Roche 'Stone-thrower' Diamant, Ragni Citizen

Bismuthinite.lore: An extremely rare metallic ore only found within the island region of Corkus, it is normally used in decorative dyes. However, a mishap one day caused the discovery of strange and cumulative effects when exposed to traditional magicks.

Olympic.lore: When one has climbed the highest mountain, traversed the vastest plain, what is left to conquer? One challenges the human limit, and attempts to push beyond what any has accomplished before. Sculpted in honor of the first champion, this idol emboldens you to best your greatest opponent: yourself.

Ignis.lore: This bow, used by the dwarves to land the final blow in the slaughter of Garaheth, is extremely powerful. Special fire resistant gloves must be worn at all times to prevent burns to the user.

majorIds.Altruism: +Altruism: Nearby players gain 100% of the health you gain from Health Regen and Life Steal.

Grimtrap.lore: Found at the site of the Caritat Mansion, this simple-looking glove is bathed in dark presence. It wracks those who wear it with pain, and instills the belief that the only way to end the pain is not to remove the item, but to inflict that same torment upon all others.

Reticence.lore: Many old mages had to perform lengthy incantations to make potent even their simplest spells. A mage cursed to be mute, however, brought upon a revolution to spellcasting through this simple wand.

Keen Eye.lore: This bow, which grants its wielder the gift of increased sight, was forged by a blind blacksmith determined to protect others from his sightless fate.

Erratio.lore: The blind prophet who crafted this macabre breastplate used the bones of only the most ruthless justiciars and executioners. Its wearers are supposedly destined to only die either a heroic or a just death.

Toxoplasmosis.lore: Can you feel the burning inside? Something has made itself at home. Time to tuck away the parts of you it has no need for, to shuffle your little brain around so you may Carry. Carry and Spread. Give it a new home—melting you down is how it says thank you. Be grateful, won't you?

Iron Knuckle.lore: These bulky-looking gauntlets are actually extremely lightweight, being created of a magical elf-blessed iron alloy blend.

Idol.lore: Intricate carvings and images, almost like that of a totem pole, cover the shaft of this marvelous trident, dredged up from the Seavale Reef. Foreign magics heighten the senses of its user in battle, but also instills a longing for the ocean. Many have succumbed to this urge and drowned themselves.

majorIds.Tidal Drift: +Tidal Drift: Flying Kick will instead send you forwards. This effect is limited to once per Charge cast.

Upgraded Melange.lore: There are parts from at least six separately recognizable weapons mashed together to make this. There's no way it's effective.

Silver Solar Ring.lore: The device forged into this simple ring seems to absorb heat. You feel a bit lukewarm when wearing it...

Radiation.lore: Radioactive emissions caused by starfall seeps into the mind, the atoms, the Soul. Transfiguring organic matter into something new, something sinister. It's only through sheer force of will that victims of such a thing break free from themselves, and their imperfect vessels... into something beautiful.

Stifling Spores.lore: The beauty of this peculiar grotto takes your breath away. Unfortunately, its spores do too...

majorIds.Plague: +Plague: Poisoned mobs spread their poison to nearby mobs.

Locrian.lore: Skien's trust in others was shattered permanently by the wielder of this dagger, who fell to the corruption and attacked his legion during a great corrupted siege.

Fleetfooted Tome of the Marathon II.internalName: Fleetfooted Tome of the Marathon II

Carnage Agglomerate.lore:
Behind you are the corpses of the weak, of those who deserved to die. Before you are those willing to join them.
It's pulling towards something.

majorIds.Displace: +Displace: Wind Slash deals massive knockback to enemies hit by Teleport.

Shinespark.lore: There have been many attempts to create a reliable power system in Llevigar, and this plasma-charged helmet was reforged from a notable prototype.

Eyes on All.lore: A presence of despair watches over the swamp as the Decay spreads.

Field.lore: "After the Nivla forest fire, I'm glad the corrupteds haven't thought to try and burn the Detlas Suburbs." -Sergeant Klafson, Detlas Legion

Martingale.lore: Every power has its costs, and every triumph has its toll. Wager everything you treasure—it will all be worth in the end.

Sting.lore: "I swear on my life those spiders were covered in spikes! Go out there, see if I'm wrong!" -Suri, Elemental Researcher

Continuum.lore: From nothing to everything, forever past to forever more, the vastness of eternity is obscured by the sameness of tomorrow.

Guardian.lore: A vow of protection hangs over this spear, now inhabited by the spirit of a legendary heroine. Even simply a glimpse of the burning blade will instill a feeling of protection and security, and that feeling will hold true if one is brave enough to wield it.

majorIds.Guardian: +Guardian: 35% of damage taken by nearby allies is redirected to you.

Contrast.lore: The runes carved onto the gold beads strung along this simple necklace translate into various words meaning variance. It provides many abilities though unexplainable means.

Omnia Mors.lore:
Everything dies. Show those who resist the foolishness of their ambitions.
It's pulling towards something.

majorIds.Flurry of Blows: +Flurry of Blows: Turn Double Slice into a 10-hit pummeling of 16% damage per hit.

Stalagmites.lore: Although these boots are crafted from corrupted stone, they do not exhibit any corruptive effects on their wearers. Speculation abounds as to the reason.

Courageous Tome of Defensive Mastery I.internalName: Courageous Tome of Defensive Mastery I

Insignia.lore: To wear the mark is more than a show of allegiance. It is a willingness to channel the might of the gods at whatever cost, as the fate of the battle is worth more than surviving to see its end.

majorIds.Superconductor: +Superconductor: Chain Lightning channels three massive lightning bolts through you, arcing to enemies within 8 blocks for 225% and stunning them for 1s. You take 10% more damage for 4s.

Gert Super Special Magic Ultistick.lore: Well...it is a very pretty-looking stick, but aside from that it just appears to be a plain old stick.

Anchoryl.lore: Despite being a much smaller settlement compared to the mighty citadel of Rodoroc, the dwarven smiths of Thanos still can forge mighty products, such as these heavy diamond-alloy boots.

Nether's Scar.lore: Forged directly from the bloody red stone mined from the Nether, they were locked away for fear of inciting insanity in those who wore them.

Found Footage.lore: Despite heavy damage, this memory core recovered from a fallen Despermech remains usable. Sifting through its contents paints a clear yet brutal picture of the destruction the rogue creations have caused.

Boreal.lore: The last known crafts of Theorick before his fall in battle were pieces of armour crafted out of pure ice, all of which have melted save for these shimmering boots. The coldest gales and most suffocating heat nurture and repair the wearer instead of being stifling or deadly.

Xenolith.lore: Hidden amongst the foundations of the Expanse are anomalous fragments wrapped in an otherworldly power. While unsettling to the touch, the strength they impart is too tempting to ignore.

Apocalypse.lore: To forge a weapon such as this from the cursed lava of the portal basin requires dozens, for each smith would lose themselves to the force of corruption before it is finished. The nightmarishly hooked blade serves no purpose but destruction, as intended.

majorIds.Hellfire: +Hellfire: Bash is replaced by a single hit, gaining +3 radius and dealing +85%, +10%, and +60%. Boiling Blood's cooldown is set to 2s, gains +40%, +50%, and burns twice as fast for 1s, but can't slow.

Tenuto.lore: This strange pendant has been known to dilate time around the wearer, slowing their movements while greatly augmenting their power.

Stronghold.lore: The cost of survival is immense, with morale running thin and supply lines choked, feeding the strength of an army condensed to a single point, of a people desperate not to give an inch.

Heaven's Gate.lore: Among the outcasts of Efilim, some preach that death is not to be feared. They say while the road to his door is hellish, and his messenger most cruel, the beyond forgives. In this gilded spear, you see not only a weapon, but a key, a ticket. You know what to do. Be the messenger.

Dead Sands.lore: Found in the middle of the Almuj desert, these greaves slowly engulf everything around it in flames. The heat of the desert sun has seared it heavily, empowering it with the fury of the Sun.

Upgraded Archpriest.lore: It seems stronger at first glance, but upon closer inspection the blade is rather...soft?

Schadenfreude.lore: It's a wicked dream come true—their purpose is pain, both others' and their own; their will is naught but your command.

majorIds.Strings of Fate: +Strings of Fate: Your puppets have a lifetime of 3 seconds and deal double damage with attacks and explosions.

Surefooted Tome of the Marathon I.internalName: Surefooted Tome of the Marathon I

Garoth's Hope.lore: "Strangest thing, it turns out Creepers are incredibly flammable..." -Garull, Cryptid Researcher

Fragile Truce.lore: The enemy of your enemy is your friend. It’s naught but a ceasefire of convenience, if not necessity, yet it’s a chance to lick your wounds and focus your might against the threat at hand.

Binding Brace.lore: An oppressively dark aura emanates from this shackle, dampening both the will and magic potency of those that wear it.

Earth Sanctuary.lore: The heart of the earth, where the ground blooms beautiful blossoms and life grows untethered.

Philosopher.lore: What better excuse is there to sit in the shade and think about life?

majorIds.Peaceful Effigy: +Peaceful Effigy: Your Totem will last twice as long.

Antebellum.lore: Only the naive celebrate a ceasefire. Not a second wasted, a merciless arms race against the inevitability of war has left you ready to unleash hell the moment the armistice breaks.

Lodestone.lore: The magical oddity known as lodestone has been studied for years as an active counterpart to quartz's passive magical properties. Research continues, but it is valuable when creating magical items.

Firebird.lore: From the ashes, let a hero rise anew.

majorIds.Phoenix-Born: +Phoenix-Born: Health Regeneration is increased by 0.75% for every 1% Health missing.

majorIds.Escape Route: +Escape Route: Frenzy and Time Dilation charge twice as fast but also decay twice as fast.

The Scavenged.lore: To the victor go the spoils. To the swift, go the spoils of the victor.

Passus Lux.lore: A brilliant relic supposedly originating from the Realm of Light, the creators of these strangely shaped boots are completely unknown.

majorIds.Lightweight: +Lightweight: You no longer take fall damage.

Enhanced Panorama.lore: They added stilts to the leggings, so that they could "live up to the name." The fact you can barely stand in them is neatly avoided when you ask.

Precious.lore: A strange magic attracts you to this ring. Maybe you shouldn't tell anyone about its existence?

Clairvoyance.lore: The powerful psychic energies surrounding this bow are rumored to increase accuracy, though this has not been refuted by any reliable source.

Gold Steam Bracelet.lore: This impressive bracelet is in high demand. Those who have obtained it say that they feel as if they're "one with the wind" when wearing it.

Fighter's Tome of Combat Mastery I.internalName: Fighter's Tome of Combat Mastery I

Aestival Solstice.lore: Enjoy the sun that has graced you with its longest daylight, and cherish it so that you can carry forth its warmth.

Hashr Claw.lore: "Betrayal stings sharper than a scorpion's tail, and festers worse than the poison inside."   -Attributed to Hashr

Pain Cycle.lore: Every ounce of your suffering must be made worth it. Otherwise, what was the point of it all?

majorIds.Gruesome Knots: +Gruesome Knots: Bleeding and Twisted Tether deal double damage, but Bleeding duration is reduced.

Coeur Brise.lore: Left to brittle introspection, love unrequited stings the most when it brings down something built to last.

Upgraded Cursed Bow.lore: "100% curse-free or your money back!" The merchant explained that this policy is not legally binding after you read it.

Disco.lore: Recovered from a corrupted soldier who wore them, it was found dancing instead of attacking those around it. Even after it was killed, it jostled and jerked around like a dancing puppet.

Diamond Static Bracelet.lore: The heavy shocks coming from this perfected bracelet would be lethal under normal circumstances, but the only thing its wearer senses is the enhancement of power.

Terminal Velocity.lore:
Don't give them time for even a warning.
It's pulling towards something.

majorIds.Tackle: +Tackle: Flying Kick deals much more knockback and increases Collide damage by an additional 150%, 60%, and 10%.

Slider.lore: The spelling seems to have been botched.

majorIds.Alter Ego: +Alter Ego: Awakened can be activated after saving 40% less mana, but its duration is reduced by 25%.

Phantasmal Remnants.lore: Memories take on lives of their own, left long enough.

Mesmerizing Madness.lore: Sink into infinite synchronous beats with the intricate rhythm of fractals and spirals and patterns, and patterns, and patterns that reach to the pulsating stars and then back to the ground where the people are dancing to songs they don't know under stars that turn ‘round, and around, and around, as the spiral is starting again . . .

Beige Wynnter Sweater.lore: The sweater has the quote "All STOCKINGED up for the season" knitted onto the front.

Panic Zealot.lore: They must know what you went through. They must suffer the same as you did.

majorIds.Furious Effigy: +Furious Effigy: Totem effects are twice as fast, but duration is halved.

Thunderbolt.lore: This bow has no string. Instead, a thin lightning-like thread is strung upon it. It is said to be limited only by the speed of the user.

Vampiric Tome of Defensive Mastery II.internalName: Vampiric Tome of Defensive Mastery II

Soundwave.lore: This bow's thick string fails to shoot arrows effectively, but instead produces low frequency sound waves that erupt from the source in all directions. The sound can implode the eardrums of an enemy with a single strum.

Fighter's Tome of Combat Mastery III.internalName: Fighter's Tome of Combat Mastery III

majorIds.Last Resort: +Last Resort: Bloodlust has doubled corrupted scaling and knockback, but deals -100% -60%.

Pulse Storm.lore: In the shadow of the Sun, a storm of unmistakable hatred follows. One which, however ephemeral, may only yield to the great pyres like these in the minutes it has to spare.

Libra.lore: Before the invention of magical weight detectors, there was a giant pair of public scales in Cinfras. Instead of being thrown away, they were reforged to be a formidable piece of armour.

Olux's Prized Wand.lore: This expertly crafted wand was shaped by a cryptid-researching fanatic. It shimmers with the purest water from the swamp.

Equinox Blossom.lore: Perennial, in a sense—these plants cycle through a unique bloom for every season. When they fully form, the breathtaking equinox is said to shine with an otherworldly light.

Convergence.lore: As the void approaches nearer and nearer, the barrier between realms thins almost to a point... And yet, no matter how far you fall or how fast you fly, it will always lie just out of reach. Such is the indeterminate nature of the void, and its power that you harness.

Inclemency.lore:
Only the strongest are able to survive Nesaak's unforgivingly harsh conditions. From the frigid temperatures to the vicious wildlife and grotesque corrupteds, life here can feel like challenge after challenge.
It's pulling towards something.

majorIds.Gentle Glow: +Gentle Glow: Orphion's Pulse restores up to 25% more max health to allies, but heals at a slower rate. Fluid Healing's effectiveness is increased by 150%.

Temporal Lantern.lore: No eyes see past the dark fog that enshrouds the future. But if you could perhaps light the way, what would you see? Invigorating hope? Or a warning to be heeded?

majorIds.Pounce: +Pounce: Escape becomes a forward lunge.

Hesperium.lore: Watch as they receive your gift of imminent disaster and endless fallout.

majorIds.Fission: +Fission: Explosions from your Exploding ID are twice as big and twice as strong.

Olux's Prized Bow.lore: This expertly crafted bow was whittled by a cryptid-researching fanatic. Its frame was cut from the very toughest tree roots.

majorIds.Cherry Bombs: +Cherry Bombs: Turns Smoke Bomb into firecrackers that fly farther, tighter, and deal 100%, 30%, 30%, and 30% instantly.

Conspirator's Trickpockets.lore: No reign lasts forever. Not while your schemes remain unnoticed.

Esoteric Tome of Combat Mastery III.internalName: Esoteric Tome of Combat Mastery III

Witherhead's Talisman.lore: "My dear boy should never have to go through the horrors of losing a mother like that." -Momo, adoptive mother of Bob

Stale.lore: "There's never new water flowing into those sewers. It all cycles back into itself...not natural." -Jenprest, Ragni Legion 2nd Division

Silver Hydro Necklace.lore: You'll be wise like the sea, the merchant said. Although you notice the built-in device's abilities, you feel space for an upgrade.

Chained Pixels.lore: Materials of all sorts have been lashed together in this crude, blocky set of leggings. From darksteel to leather to rotting wood, each part is a perfect square. It has, so far, been impossible to recreate.

Relic.lore: Despite being proven unrelated, this enigmatic bow was the lynchpin to beginning the great search for the Relics.

Diamond Steam Ring.lore: Users of this perfect model of Legendary Island's steam-powered ring have reported feeling weightless in combat. The jewel of the ring is a perfectly clear diamond.

Megalophobia.lore: Each level deeper into the ocean only harbors stranger and more eerie creatures than before. Though their alien nature is disquieting, it is the way the trend sees no end that worries you the most.

Nimble Tome of Combat Mastery II.internalName: Nimble Tome of Combat Mastery II

The Forsaken.lore: "In the days before they ripped out its heart, there was a pulse to these streets: the sanguine flow of life through the sturdy buildings and cobbled roads and hidden alleys. What remains is a bloodless husk, dusty walls populated solely by those hideous things which can only see and never know."

Sweet Memories.lore: The feel of cool cream. The savory satisfaction of fatty stew. The bittersweetness of chocolate. Luxuries long since lost alongside what once was, tastes and sensations you can't find anymore. It's enough to bring a man to bitter, bitter tears.

Upgraded Whisper.lore: The blade seems sharper than normal, but it also seems rather brittle. The smithing was obviously a hack-job...

The Forgery.lore: While only a mockery of the original product, this line of helmets became wildly popular before legal disputes and safety concerns halted production.

Gold Static Ring.lore: The strong shock coming from this advanced version of the ring is a small price for its power, but it has yet to reach its peak.

Bonder.lore: It looks like they spelled the name wrong...

majorIds.Magnet: +Magnet: Pulls items dropped by mobs towards you.

majorIds.Entropy: +Entropy: Meteor's speed is increased by 50%.

Sweeping Majesty.lore: Echoes of the Fracturing persist in the Sky at scales unimaginable, implying a power so all-encompassing it leaves you in awe.

Nimble Tome of Combat Mastery III.internalName: Nimble Tome of Combat Mastery III

Cephalothorax.lore: "...Most of their vital organs, however, are located in the bulbous abdomen. If you've enough crushing force with your weapon, it may be a quicker alternative for the kill. ..." -Admiral Aegis' Guide To Nivla Threats, Chapter 3

Cracked Stonehall.lore: It looks like someone tried and failed to improve it. The re-smithing job was obviously rushed...

Anya's Penumbra.lore: "The lightest light will never defeat the darkest dark. Only those who understand both can survive."

Impossibility Threshold.lore: Visions unknowable and faces unnamed. A violent cacophony with no end in sight. But beyond that- a clarity. A fleeting moment where the rules speak their names, just on the other side. You need to get closer. You need to be able to see.

Abrasion.lore: "The fractures have ground the land to dust, our home to ruin, and our people to nothing."

Chipped Glitz.lore: There are little chips and cracks all over this... was someone trying to break it down for gold?

majorIds.Lightweight: +Lightweight: You no longer take fall damage.

requirements.quest: Realm of Light V - The Realm of Light

Fissure.lore: Dwarven folklore tells of this mighty maul, used by gods to break mountains, shape continents, and crack the earth to form caverns.

majorIds.Temblor: +Temblor: Bash gains +1 Area of Effect and is 0.05s faster.

Glass Skin.lore:
Peeled off of a desiccated corpse, what remains of the skin is brittle. A precise enough strike can crack the wrapping and embed sharp fragments straight into the wearer's wrist.
It's pulling towards something.

The Swarm.lore: The scratching in the walls is the only warning you get.

Nitrogen.lore: A bow drawn from the air itself. It imbues the wielder with all the spirit of the wind.

Gold Static Bracelet.lore: The painful shock coming from this improved version of the ring is a small price for its power, but it has yet to reach its peak.

Aquarius.lore: “The symbol of the river” is a name that is often synonymous with this garment, with many water like qualities surrounding it, heavily bathed in magical meaning.

Nepta Floodbringer.lore: Combined power of inscribed Uth runes and immense wisdom meld to create a commanding aura, as this weapon is merely a spiritual extension of the user's desire for dominion over all.

Cyclonic Tome of Combat Mastery III.internalName: Cyclonic Tome of Combat Mastery III

Trance.lore: Down. Your enemies will fall slack. Deeper. Do you know this compulsion you bring? Deeper still. This implement, reaching from within and without. Even deeper. Souls and wills to command at the flex of a finger. Almost gone. It is my compulsion, too great to ignore. It is my implement, too strong to resist. My puppets, too deep to escape. Drop.

majorIds.Fixate: +Fixate: Devitalize doubles your Winded cap, but lowers Winded damage effects by 30%. Timelock absorbs up to 120 Winded.

Apex Predator.lore: Something must always rule the ecosystem, even one as warped as this.

Rigor Mortis.lore:
After this crossbow's original wielder fell in battle, its mechanisms stiffened and locked into place. A spark of life, or undeath, can temporarily reverse the effect before the weapon seizes up again.
It's pulling towards something.

Runebound Chains.lore: You know better than anyone else that there’s always a sliver of truth behind the tallest of tales.

majorIds.Sorcery: +Sorcery: 25% chance for spells and attacks to cast a second time at no additional cost.

Royal Blazing Amulet.lore: An exclusive amulet given to the most honored knights of Wynn. It glows with a comforting warmth.

Tachypsychia.lore: You will probably irreversibly harm yourself with this, but when has that ever stopped you?

majorIds.Furious Effigy: +Furious Effigy: Totem effects are twice as fast, but duration is halved.

Galleon.lore: Forged with the raw powers of both the earth and the sea, these boots were initially an attempt at creating a method of foot-travel over the seas. Despite the spectacular failure of that application, they remain a formidable and reliable set of armor.

requirements.quest: Realm of Light III - A Headless History

Syncope.lore: The soul of a Devil is so hot with hatred that their  bodies melt like candle wax, coming off in molten globs of flesh until only black bones remain.

majorIds.Heat Shimmer: +Heat Shimmer: Foul Play will no longer slay a Mirror Clone and will still provide its effects, but Mirror Clone count is reduced to 1. Tricks application is increased by 50%.

Doomsday Omen.lore: Something is lurking—it must be, in the eerie silence that leaves you so utterly alone. And these remains… Are they a reminder of one who didn’t stay quiet, or does what lurks in the unknown already know you’re here?

Gold Solar Bracelet.lore: The device forged into this improved bracelet seems to gather heat. You can feel a warming sensation all over your arm...

Little Inferno.lore: It is cold to the touch until worn. Once donned, it engulfs the wearer in excruciatingly hot flames, but never shall the wearer burn; only their enemies will feel the pain of the fire.

Athanasia.lore: May your triumphs live eternal and never fade.

Blossom Haze.lore: And as the spring bursts, the blossom petals flutter in the wind amongst the ashes of your enemies.

majorIds.Cherry Bombs: +Cherry Bombs: Turns Smoke Bomb into firecrackers that fly farther, tighter, and deal 100%, 30%, 30%, and 30% instantly.

Boreal-Patterned Crown.lore: Engraved with the beauty and mystery of the boreal lights, this ornately-crafted crown is given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.

Maelstrom.lore: Lost by master sailor Carvel in a massive storm, it was carried all the way out to the city of Selchar, where it was found spewing seafoam and lightning bolts.

majorIds.Perilous Flare: +Perilous Flare: Pyrokinesis moves much slower, but has an increased Area of Effect and  +50%.

Yellow Wynnter Sweater.lore: The sweater has the quote "YELLOW- How's your Craftmas going" knitted onto the front.

Brise.lore: "With the hot, dry winds from the Roots and the cold, wet winds from Nesaak, these houses rot faster than you can blink." -Viraex, Elkurn Citizen

Gravity.lore: No one knows how this extremely dense chestplate can even logically exist. It is almost paradoxical in nature, and affects its wearers in unfathomable ways.

majorIds.Magnet: +Magnet: Pulls items dropped by mobs towards you.

Collapse.lore: Despite the light weight of the weapon, the spearhead has been made from incredibly dense cosmic stone. A strong enough impact can directly destroy matter. Due to this danger, it is sought after to be destroyed.

majorIds.Fission: +Fission: Explosions from your Exploding ID are twice as big and twice as strong.

Diamond Static Necklace.lore: The lethal amount of electricity emmited from this often desired necklace fails to kill you, as its pure energy runs through your veins.

Sodeta Boots.lore: These boots were standard issue to members of the prestigious, and now disbanded, Sodeta Guild, and given as a gift to the owners of Delnar Mansion one day.

Cerid's Ingenuity.lore: One of the master tinkerer Cerid's greatest inventions, these odd gear-laced boots clink and chime with the sound of clockworks keeping its powerful magic dynamos constantly running.

Twin Minds.lore: It takes two voices to make harmony.

Phlebotomy.lore: Rivers will run red in your wake.

majorIds.Cannulate: +Cannulate: Sacrificial Shrine costs -5 Blood Pool to cast and health drain is halved.

Jaw Breaker.lore: "Bandit attacks losing you sleep? Free fighting classes here! Only 10 emeralds- they won't know what hit 'em!" -Almuj Self-Defense Class Advertisement

Jiandan Handwraps.lore: The cloth wraps produced by the canyon Dojo are just that, merely soft cloth. It is left to the users to apply them skillfully in battle, in whatever way they see fit.

Spring.lore: Arrows fired by this bow are pure ice, but when they hit the enemy, burst into magical water, flash-freezing all that it touches. The frost burns will never heal.

Revered Silver Mask of Legendary Victory.internalName: Revered Silver Mask of Legendary Victory
Revered Silver Mask of Legendary Victory.lore: This ornate decorative mask, fashioned from pure silver, is awarded to those who have spent an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge and broken the mold by continuing to spend an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge.

Outrage.lore: \[Community Event Winner\] This battered stone mask is of unknown origin, and has no openings for the eyes whatsoever. Indeed, all that can be seen while wearing it is that which makes you truly angry.

majorIds.Geocentrism: +Geocentrism: Aura radiates from you instead of your Totem and can be cast any time.

Bronze Basic Bracelet.lore: This bracelet is awarded to participants of the Legendary Challenge. Its modular design allows it to be upgraded in a number of different ways.

Dondasch.lore: The sheer bond between Adamastor and Urdar has manifested itself into a physical form due to their duress. Such power is not to be abused...

Abysso Galoshes.lore: Rumored to be crafted from a Dernic stone, these sinister boots radiate extremely powerful dark energy. They have absorbed the power of the raging seas in their time locked in Sarnfic.

Succession.lore: "I pray that those who have heeded the wise one’s warning have survived. The canyon must not meet this fate."

Afterimage.lore: This wand is capable of attacks so fast that it appears to flicker in and out of existence. Anyone able to access its full potential will be seen as only a blur to their enemies.

majorIds.Gentle Glow: +Gentle Glow: Orphion's Pulse restores up to 25% more max health to allies, but heals at a slower rate. Fluid Healing's effectiveness is increased by 150%.

Brutality.lore: Her crimes were against Man. She killed and broke, leaving lifeless bodies piled in her wake, and snuffing lives with horrific indifference.

Heliophilia.lore: This peculiar shawl is eternally warm to the touch, and shimmers brilliantly in the sunlight. It is rumored to give amazing health benefits and good fortune to those who wear it.

Bob's Battle Chestplate.lore: This battered chestplate was once worn by the legendary Wynnic protector, Bob, during the fearsome corrupted sieges before he gave it away to an old friend. An air of melancholy hangs over it.

Diablo.lore: One of the most unstable wands known to man. Using the bark of the Flerisi trunk, it reaps fiery destruction upon its enemies.

Compliance.lore: "All of our faith, all of our worship, and we were rewarded with the apocalypse."

Scorpion.lore: This dagger has no blade. Instead, it is layered with the stingers of the Black Shadow Scorpion, which has the ability to vanish entirely from its prey.

Pareidolia.lore: Faces have danced around you as long as you can remember, laughing, jeering, mocking. This is your surrender, casting faces of your own into the theatre of your humiliation.

Nostalgia.lore: It once held little meaning, another lilac left unnoticed in the quotidian meadows of yesteryear. Yet just its scent brings forth a deluge of memory, crashing down with the force of a time long past.

Tenacity.lore: The strength to keep going, to push on in the face of adversity. It's a rare kind of grit, the one that takes hold and won't let go until the task is done.

Black Catalyst.lore: Even simply looking at these odd rings gives way to a compulsion to wear two of them, despite all better judgement.

Royal Shocking Amulet.lore: An exclusive amulet given to the most honored knights of Wynn. It crackles with a chaotic energy.

Cypress Amber.lore:
"Discernable by it's one-second glow, the cypress firefly makes it home amidst the ash of the upper heights, blending in with the fiery landscape."
 -Delinaed's Guide to Local Species, 2nd Edition.

majorIds.Perilous Flare: +Perilous Flare: Pyrokinesis moves much slower, but has an increased Area of Effect and  +50%.

Abdomen.lore: "...But under no circumstances should you stand directly behind an attacking spider. While not a universal trait, some spiders are capable of ejecting webs from their spinneret, leaving assailants and victims helpless." -Admiral Aegis' Guide To Nivla Threats, Chapter 3

Spiritshock.lore: Recovered from the Lexdale Penitentiary, this grisly bow holds destructive capabilities. Used to carry out executions, a precise enough shot can shatter the soul of those it hits.

Witherhead's Elbow.lore: Wielded by the master of the Decrepit Sewers Dungeon, the arrows of this bow causes the target's body to slowly wither away.

Crystal.lore: Forged on Mage Island, the sparkling liquid-like armour is as hard as obsidian, but light and fluid as water. It glistens with the magic of the ocean winds.

Empathy Purge.lore:
Tiny spikes lining the inside of these boots suppress the grey matter in the wearer's brain, enhancing their capabilities and making them capable of murderous and immoral acts while in this trance-like, numbed state.
It's pulling towards something.

Cascade.lore: A great magical cataclysm at Mage Island brought on by a strange, seemingly disconnected series of events resulted in this wand absorbing nearly uncontrollably high levels of magic.

Momentum.lore: This golden cuff has an odd time dilation effect surrounding it, slowing all movements significantly, but multiplying the force of impact to a significant degree.

Gold Fusion Bracelet.lore: This bracelet, decorated with complex ornaments, uses built-in micro-devices to boost its users elemental abilites. Though powerful, there's still a lot to improve.

Suspended Soliloquy.lore: No one can hold you down anymore.

majorIds.Inversion: +Inversion: Teleport will grant you 3 seconds of levitation.

Brass Brand.lore: Built by Cerid to accrue raw static charge from the surroundings and direct it at opponents, the blade's chief failing is that the wielder is not rendered immune to their own discharge as intended.

Durum's Serenity.lore: Carried by the Durum Protector, this small necklace holds but an ounce of the vibrance and life of the Durum Isles.

Tisaun's Valor.lore: Tisaun, a warrior tasked to fend off a corrupted siege alone, could find only a thin shirt and rusted spear to use before the attack. He defeated all 1000 enemies without taking a scratch, and his bravery infused his gear with that same strength.

Tidebinder.lore: This mysterious, half-liquid trident apparently holds the secret magics to control the ocean's ebb and flow. It is incapable of touching solid ground.

Transplanted Psyche.lore: There’s a new voice in your head. An echo, a scratch at the back of your brain, bursting with all the memories of a life you’ve never led and the desires of a will you do not hold and the fears of a mind that is not yours. Won’t you let it out? After all, two hearts beat stronger than one.

Rikter.lore: Named for an ancient Wynnic word for "Earthquake", this mighty battle hammer causes the very bones of struck enemies to rattle and heave as though the earth itself was splitting under their feet.

Hunger.lore: Forgotten long ago, these boots curse the wearer with an endless hunger.

Gold Hydro Bracelet.lore: You'll fight strong like the tide, the merchant said. Indeed, you begin to notice how your senses sharpen. But is that the limit...?

Diamond Solar Ring.lore: The device forged into this flawless ring draws all heat from its surrounding. Though it almost burns, you can feel your abilites enhance.

Extinction.lore: The Decay swept away countless species. As those memories die, they are lost forever.

Eleventh Hour.lore: The last stand, a hero's rally, a turning tide—is it a tale of a champion who conquered, or a martyr who inspired? This is your story to tell.

majorIds.Saviour's Sacrifice: +Saviour's Sacrifice: While under 50% maximum health, nearby allies gain 15% bonus damage and defence.

Lunar Spine.lore: From the Nether Gate, a shard of cosmic stone was ejected. Its purity was defiled, and the first man to wield it went mad, raving about the fall of the cosmos' beauty.

Maul.lore: "If you squish a spider egg, sometimes little spiders pop out. So, squish the whole area instead!" -Captain Fenor, Detlas Legion

Gaea-Hewn Boots.lore: Forged in direct tribute to the earth and its aspects, these ornately-crafted boots are given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.

Bright Edge.lore: A blade of pure light forms in your hands. It moves of its own accord, a blinding radiance dancing through your enemies, using you as a vessel for its brilliance.

Thriller.lore: "And no one's going to save us from the beasts about to strike. We've seen horrors stare us in the eyes, and we're fighting for our lives." -Poe, Nemract Sewer Dweller

Matryoshka Shell.lore: The armor worn by the enigmatic Matryoshka Idol. It appears to have a nearly uncountably high number of inlets and sockets set inside.

majorIds.Sublimation: +Sublimation: Totemic Shatter heals 75% of Regeneration's usual amount at the cost of 2 blocks of radius.

Woebegone.lore:
For some, the psychological impact of the undead incursions becomes too much to bear. They leave their lives behind hoping to find solace, only to return as an undead themselves.
It's pulling towards something.

Neolithic.lore: This ancient stone-hewn helmet is blended with the bones of an extinct animal of some kind. It is harder than dragon's hide.

Memento.lore: All those who wear these enchanted boots deposit a single fond memory into them. They are forgotten forever, but wearing them recalls every memory within vividly.

False Idol.lore: Without your god, whom else is there to turn to but me?

majorIds.Sun Eater: +Sun Eater: Failing to backstab an enemy from behind blinds them for 0.5s and slows them by 20% for 5s.

Defibrillator.lore: "The first time I saw one of those zombies I nearly had a heart attack! The blighters are terrifying." -Rynend, Maltic Citizen

Black.lore: Hewn from the great obsidian spires surrounding the massive Nether gate, this fiercely-hooked dagger absorbs light and magic energy alike to create a desolate void wherever it is wielded.

Outlandish Replica Face Mask of Legendar.internalName: Outlandish Replica Face Mask of Legendary Victory
Outlandish Replica Face Mask of Legendar.lore: This perfect-to-the-point-of-indistinguishability replica mask of Herbert von Legendary's face, painstakingly crafted by Corkus's most powerful machines with only the most expensive materials and featuring real moustache hair plucked from Doctor Legendary's face, is desperately handed over to attempt to placate those who have spent an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge, broken the mold by continuing to spend an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge, gone even further beyond spending unnecessary amounts of time completing the Legendary Challenge, pushed onward to prove that they will not stop spending unnecessary amounts of time completing the Legendary Challenge, and then ultimately garnered an unhealthy obsession for spending unnecessary amounts of time completing the Legendary Challenge.

Obstinance.lore: "The protector will keep us safe even after this! It has to, it must, it—"

Enhanced Skeleton Boots.lore: Some of the bones used to make the frame of the boots have crumbled. The merchant refuses to comment.

Silver Fiber Necklace.lore: This crude looking necklace utilizes electromagic to expose its wearer to earth's heartbeat. Though for now, it remains quiet.

Grand Design.lore: It’s a gravity as abstract as it is physical, of phenomena so fascinating one can’t help but be pulled in.

majorIds.Ergosphere: +Ergosphere: Storm Dance instead lets your Totems pull enemies within their radius. Totem duration is decreased.

Silk Slasher.lore: "Cut a web, and its owner will feel it and come out. That's your chance to strike." -Lieutenant Van, Detlas 2nd Regiment

Hanafubuki.lore: The most dangerous enemy is one you cannot see. Hidden amidst a flurry of petals comes an avalanche of blows, in one moment dissolving mountains and forests into a growing amalgam, leaving a wake of vibrant bloom in the next.

majorIds.Efflorescence: +Efflorescence: Jasmine Bloom deals 25% and 25% at the cost of 6 blocks of vertical range. Swan Dive deals 16% and 16%.

Sticky Decoder Ring.lore: Each one is welded stuck to just one letter. Apparently, to decode the special Rymek message, you need to buy twenty six. ...do they think you're a fool?

Discoverer.lore: Wealth and riches...but at what cost?

Herald of Ruin.lore: The calm before the storm is a time of preparation, of perseverance until clearer days. But this? This is the last moment of peace they will ever know.

majorIds.Fallout: +Fallout: Bomb Arrow gains +7.5 range, +50%, severely increased recoil, and 25% self-damage.

Cage of Bones.lore: The ancient bones of the demon Garaheth are stronger than steel. They clamp down when worn to constrict the bearer, inciting a slow madness.

Cryoseism.lore: One of the first dwarven theories of the increasing quakes in east Gavel was that the freezing of a Dogun town in the Heights also froze a massive underground spring, disrupting the earth and chain-reacting across the province.

Enhanced Duskshield.lore: They look extremely bulky and uncomfortable...do they have a right to call it "enhanced"?

Symbiont.lore: Survival is the shared interest of those in the wilds.

Titanium Grievers.lore: Crudely misshapen greaves made from haphazard scrap found about the Starfield. You sense a foreboding notion that donning such a thing would be the end of sensing anything at all.

Resurgence.lore: An antique passed from the Caritat wreckage into the hands of the outcast elves of Efilim. So to honor the memory of the selfless family as inspired their self-imposed exile, their strongest healing spells were imbued into it, and sent to those who needed them most.

Arakadicus' Body.lore: Long strips of chitin discarded from the mother of spiders Arakadicus still contain traces of her wicked powers, but few have survived the attempts to harvest them.

Divergence.lore: Strangers held together by shared past, entwined in a fray, never to unite again.

Upgraded Lullaby.lore: The inscribed lyrics have been scratched out and replaced with a barely-legible insult.

majorIds.Insoluble: +Insoluble: Dissolution now lasts 2.5 seconds, but grants only 35% resistance.

majorIds.Dead Weight: +Dead Weight: Totem's horizontal velocity is greatly increased at the cost of vertical movement.

Gold Fusion Ring.lore: This ring, covered in colorful artifical gems, seems to awaken a powerful elemental force in you. Though stronger than the previous model, its true potential stays sealed.

Iklaj.lore: "I am not making this up! That spider teleported ONTO MY FACE!" -Stiba, Elemental Researcher

majorIds.Lustrate: +Lustrate: Heal restores health at a slower rate, but Searing Light deals +150%.

Death Grasp.lore: Unspeakable things live within the shadows; waiting so patiently to take others into their ranks. Facsimiles of their existence, painted in inscrutable darkness. Nobody will see. Nobody will know. Nobody will remember.

Fantasia.lore: The confusion of sentience creates unknown and marvelous threads and soundscapes. Joy, grief, hate, love, shock, calm, they reflect back into the pattern and song of the universe. The glow of the Weave, and this brilliant, breathtaking, pale imitation of it, too, resounds in the chorus of existence—one extra layer.

majorIds.Juggle: +Juggle: Mutilate adds an additional 12 hits. All hits are reduced by -10%.

majorIds.Alter Ego: +Alter Ego: Awakened can be activated after saving 40% less mana, but its duration is reduced by 25%.

The Extinguished.lore: Everything that’s fallen down here has a purpose. Or at least, it used to. Being too far removed from said purpose will eventually smother it, but it can always be rekindled... and that’s where you come in.

Prowess.lore: The runes carved into this simple gold cuff translate into various words meaning mastery. It amplifies the ability of the wearer in mysterious ways.

Petulance.lore: Her crimes were against Decency. She laughed and spat, denying reason and making the world suffer for small vengeance.

Ingress.lore: An anomaly of invasion, for the explorers who seek purpose outside of reality.

Living Slime.lore:
It turns out that having an acidic, slightly corrupted slime attached to your hands has benefits in combat... still, you should probably get that stuff taken off before it eats the flesh away from your fingerbones.
It's pulling towards something.

Gold Digger.lore: "With the corruption seemingly tied to the emeralds dug by the Roots, people thought gold was the next best thing, the idiots." -Gerald, Retired Miner

Royal Dusty Amulet.lore: An exclusive amulet given to the most honored knights of Wynn. It shines with a powerful strength.

Virgo.lore: These common leather boots were once owned by a barbarian with no magical prowess. Instead of enchanting it, he coated the soles in corrupted shards to punish those who opposed him.

Flagellant.lore: An attempt to penetrate the depths of the abyss; a sacrifice made to a futile end. No avail. Bloodshed paved the way for bloodshed, and evil still operates while blind.

Immolation.lore: The act of self-immolation is never taken lightly, and is always a sacrifice. This idol was carved to honor one such instance, in which a master of flame burned through his life force in a final act of heroism—purging an encroaching army of the undead, saving the people of the jungle from destruction.

Lingering Twilight.lore: In the harshest reaches of the mountains, dusk brings a gentle magic to the air, prolonging the faintest vestiges of sundown before night truly falls.

Silver Solar Bracelet.lore: The device forged into this simple bracelet seems to gather heat. You feel a bit lukewarm when wearing it...

Diamond Fiber Bracelet.lore: Desired by many of the countless challengers, this bracelet allows you to sense movements over thousands of meters away. It is decorated with rough yet beautiful jewels.

Thought Energy.lore: Limitless light fills the vast expanse of your mind.  Harness even a fraction of its potential, and you can command a force to shake worlds.

Upgraded Echolocation.lore: Did the merchant really think that adding severed bat wings to the weapon would make it more authentic?

Traumerei.lore: In sleep we are unfettered, unhindered by the choices we make. In dream we are unbound, set free to the limits of imagination.

Zephra Shredder.lore: Combined power of inscribed Uth runes and sheer rage intertwine to create a fearsome sight, as this weapon is merely a spiritual extension of the user's desire for total destruction.

Fierte.lore: Only the most honourable warriors of Gavel's army are presented the fearsome, fiery spear forged from the rarest metals of the Molten Heights.

majorIds.Power Fist: +Power Fist: Striking enemies with an empty hand greatly knocks them back.

Wynnterfest 2016 Souvenir.lore: Thank you for participating in Wynnterfest 2016!

Nemract's Ruin.lore: This chestplate was originally created as a memorial ornament to the lost lives of Ancient Nemract before being reforged into a powerful piece of armor for Nemract's guard.

Carbon.lore: A wand forged from the dust of life itself. It destroys and protects in equal parts.

Master.lore: Although not truly magical by any means, the sheer craftsmanship of this ornate broach makes its wearers feel skillful.

Lower.lore: The name has got to be misspelled... It doesn't even make any sense!

Warchief.lore: Sheer strength exudes from these Orcish relics, simple sandals ill-fitting to humans or Villagers. Enchanted with power and rage rather than magic, the strength that is provided when they are worn is unparalleled.

Voltaic Tome of Combat Mastery III.internalName: Voltaic Tome of Combat Mastery III

Mesarock Arch.lore: The two mesa tribes once were allies until their sacred totems were stolen. Before that time, however, they often shared their talents, and this bow hewn from mesa stone was one such lost craft.

Sitis.lore: Wielding it for too long will leave one a dessicated husk, as this dull blade slowly absorbs all liquids around it.

Seismic Tome of Combat Mastery II.internalName: Seismic Tome of Combat Mastery II

Perch of the Shrouded Sun.lore: Able to withstand the grasp of claws of pure steel, the perch of the Minokawa thrums with the might of a beast that can devour the sun. Given free reign of the skies, even the brightest of stars are no match.

Royal Cyclone Amulet.lore: An exclusive amulet given to the most honored knights of Wynn. It whistles with an invigorating tune.

The Swordfish.lore: The ocean's bounty is full of many strange things. Sailor's tales of a peculiar fish with a snout like a sword and the unbelievable stories of its power thus inspired fanciful ideas in blacksmiths. The results speak for themselves.

Silver Fusion Bracelet.lore: This bracelet, decorated with simple ornaments, uses built-in micro-devices to boost its users elemental abilites. There are many upgrades to be made before it reaches its full potential.

Pink Wynnter Sweater.lore: The sweater has the quote "Going HAM on Craftmas dinner tonight" knitted onto the front.

Cluster.lore: Perhaps one is weak. To be ignored. Perhaps two are not much better. But what of five? Ten? Twenty?...

Ethereal.lore: Supposedly based off of the wand of master mage Ethe, this wand is plated with magic-focusing jewels and heavy gold, yet somehow remains entirely weightless.

Narcissist.lore: The world revolves around you, after all. It's high time you spread the news!

majorIds.Geocentrism: +Geocentrism: Aura radiates from you instead of your Totem and can be cast any time.

Granitic Mettle.lore: Sometimes it takes a heart of stone to do what must be done.

majorIds.Rock Shield: +Rock Shield: Arrow Shield's defense is increased by 10%, but its number of charges is reduced by 1.

Archangel.lore: The unwieldy, yet imposing stature of this massive sickle strikes awe into those who view it. Those who have the will to wield it, however, seem to garner respect from all those around them, as though they had become a god.

Blossom.lore: A mystical sapling native to the shores of Mage Island has been fashioned into this simple staff. Even uprooted, you notice its continuous growth.

Giant Step.lore: Found in a mystically-charged Giant ruin, these snug boots recall fond memories, incite calmness, and provide comfort for the wearer.

Event Horizon.lore: When really does the point of no return come? Is it a gentle tug, whispers ushering you calmly to the other side? Is it a stark line, the point between light and dark, life and death? Perhaps you’ll find out. Perhaps you already know.

Angel Wing Shroud.lore: Out of respect and care for the dead, bovemists cloak them in blessed shrouds to aid their spirits in passing. These efforts, however, are not respected by the dead.

Ivy Whip.lore: "The vines you'll find among the foliage make for great rope!" -Alekin's Guide to Plant Fiber Cordage

Song of Solitude.lore: It is an apathy born from lonely desperation with which one sends a blinding ray as their signal flare, uncaring if it hails friend or foe.

majorIds.Pioneer's Echo: +Pioneer's Echo: Phantom Ray deals two bursts of  150%,  60% over 1 second. Decimator's increase and cap are raised to 140%.

Corpse.lore: "Catch a fresh-raised corrupted, it's like catching a soldier without his morning coffee. Stumbly and unfocused." -Enzan, Retired Ragni Soldier

Valse Vaincue.lore: The Wanderer; the Betrayer; the Lunatic.

Soul Ink.lore: Taken from the Archwraith by a pious Shaman, this chestplate was immediately abandoned. Its few users since have turned to an all-consuming desire to seek out and realign the last vestiges of purity remaining in the Kander Forest.

Impact Winter.lore: Do you think you can survive with a sky choked by snow and ash? More importantly, do you think anything else can?

majorIds.Flashfreeze: +Flashfreeze: Ice Snake travels instantly.

Sanguine Spaulder.lore:
Blood, gore, and bone fragments have congealed to your shoulder with the power of sheer corruption. The longer the mass is attached to you, the more of you it takes when you try to remove it.
It's pulling towards something.

Veneration.lore: Revel in the respect you've finally earned.

Diamond Hydro Ring.lore: You'll move quick like a river, the merchant said, and no word was a lie. With this ring on your finger, you could catch a gnat without looking.

Aleph Null.lore: It's a strange feeling, running forever to reach the horizon knowing another lies just as far past.

Upgraded Vartija.lore: The guard on the spear is smaller, but at least twice as thick. What purpose does that have?

Blooming Tome of Defensive Mastery I.internalName: Blooming Tome of Defensive Mastery I

Gold Hydro Necklace.lore: You'll be wise like the sea, the merchant said. Indeed, you begin to notice how your senses sharpen. But is that the limit...?

Axiom.lore: Let the land before you serve as the script for your words to write anew.

majorIds.Reality Revision: +Reality Revision: Phasing Beam instead makes Twain's Arc explode upon hitting an enemy, dealing its damage in a 5 block radius. Twain's Arc now has extreme recoil.

Recursion.lore: To call an end a new beginning implies there ever was a beginning, or ever will be an end.

Gaia.lore: The Dernel tribes revere various nature deities, each in their own unique fashions. One of the most notable was that of a lost tribe, who fashioned this blossoming stave as tribute to their deity of the earth itself.

majorIds.Earthen Splinter: +Earthen Splinter: Quake channels nature energy into a powerful root, travelling underground and emerging under the nearest mob for 1200%

majorIds.Vedette: +Vedette: Focus gets +10% damage per stack, but caps at 2. Crepuscular Ray can be cast at 2 Focus with decreased Focus drain, launching you into the air and immobilizing you.

Cruel Sun.lore: The ember manifests kindness. The blaze manifests cruelty. Both share an origin within the sun's flame. But what separates warmth from ruin is not the fire, but the hand that calls upon it. Mercy and wrath are merely reflections cast by the same unblinking star.

Gold Fusion Necklace.lore: This necklace, decorated with bright jewels, uses advanced nano-technology to boost its users elemental abilities. Though powerful, there are still a few flaws to be fixed.

Viscera Burst.lore:
Innards, outwards.
It's pulling towards something.

majorIds.Fallout: +Fallout: Bomb Arrow gains +7.5 range, +50%, severely increased recoil, and 25% self-damage.

The Exploited.lore: "They tear the earth open day after day after day, ripping out her most precious and vital stones, and dumping them into the abyss of their hungry, bottomless coffers. They would sell out the world for a bit of cash; after all, these stones bleed green."

majorIds.Greed: +Greed: Picking up emeralds heals you and nearby players for 8% max health.

Blue Wynnter Sweater.lore: The sweater has the quote "Don't feel BLUE- It's Craftmas!" knitted onto the front.

Platonic Ideal.lore: The intersection of what can be and what is. The apotheosis of being. Shear away the unclean, the impure, the rotten; leave only the raw, blinding truth of the self.

majorIds.Heartbeat: +Heartbeat: Arrow Shield is locked to 2 charges but deals doubled damage. Arrow Wall instead triples Arrow Shield damage and doubles Guardian Angels ammo.

Legendary Smasher.lore: Many have tried to duplicate the properties of this spear, but very few have succeeded in enchanting a spearhead with explosive magic that does not cause the spear itself to explode.

majorIds.Reckless Abandon: +Reckless Abandon: Sacrifice War Scream's defense bonus to give Tempest +5%, +15%, 5% and 3 extra hits.

Titanomachia.lore: This is futile, a fight against odds so great you may as well challenge the force of fate itself. Yet there is pride to be found in delaying the inevitable, so stand your ground and fight to the end.

majorIds.Dauntless Inferno: +Dauntless Inferno: Courage casts a series of 5 infernos that expand after the last, dealing 125% each, and grants 20% resistance instead of a damage boost.
